verdict.rationale: Vestd documents a few first-party multi-item actions: distributing equity from a share pool to one or more recipients in a single step (vestd-docs-8), and sending targeted updates to segmented stakeholder mailing lists (vestd-docs-3). These are narrow UI workflows, not a general bulk-operations capability, and no public API was found that would let an AI-native user script bulk actions (vestd-probe-3). Missing for 10: general bulk edit/action across records such as grants, shareholders and documents, documented bulk import/export, programmatic or API-driven batch operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
